decision.observation: Close view at the closed back gate: the goose stands by its dropped boot left of center; the right post carries a latch lever on the top rail (~0.755,0.22) and a tap pipe at its base (~0.80,0.40).
decision.hypothesis: Latch sparkles indicate a successful grab toggle; my earlier 'pull' attempts never moved the goose because the follow-up press landed on the latch itself rather than walkable ground. Correct sequence: beaker-grab the latch, then click open path south to walk away and pull the gate open.
decision.memory: After a right-click grab, the subsequent left-click must be on open ground to walk/pull.
